alt: Cyberbien, Ræv og LUPP afprøver en privat lobby i en papirverden. Værten har åbnet porten for én godkendt gæst, mens en ny anmodning venter udenfor.
prompt: Make one polished original opaque 3:2 landscape 1536×1024 LUP storybook illustration with exactly THREE named reference characters each fully recognizable and an original balanced visual composition. Preserve portraits' face, clothes, color and silhouette, give all three an active role and natural gaze. Rich mature painterly storybook textures and subtle paper grain, calm warmth, clean hierarchy with one coherent teaching story and distinctive setting, detail readable at 768px. Each character has exactly its own correct limbs and no cut faces. Render no words, labels, numbers or programming code, no logo or watermark, no fake UI. FIRST reference Cyberbien is exact small rounded golden bee with yellow-tipped dark antennae, original dark-cyan-symbol forehead goggles above expressive brown eyes, navy hoodie/yellow drawstrings, striped abdomen, cream veined wings, and dark gold-soled boots. SECOND reference is canonical Ræv, slender auburn fox with cream muzzle and chest, tall pointed ears, warm brown eyes, rust-red instructor jacket/waistcoat over cream rolled sleeves, cuffed brown trousers/boots and a single full white-tipped tail. THIRD reference is LUPP, the purple clay ROUNDED SQUARE BLOCK with two giant ivory eyes/black pupils and iconic diagonal yellow pencil with coral eraser, only that block and pencil, no feet, limbs, mouth, hair or body. Bright papercraft world on an oval table in a quiet game-design workshop with creamy paper piles, coral and teal punched craft shapes, low painted wood shelves, warm light, at roughly eye level with the miniature. Fox at left is playtester, attentively holding an open little sketch notebook with only simple sketches. LUPP on table at the center back leans toward the host play marker as if deciding. Bee at right gently indicates the visitor markers with a gloved hand, correct anatomy all around. FOCAL GAME DIORAMA is one inviting circular miniature host game room made from a ring of cream folded paper wall with a small round arch OPEN gate at front; pale lavender pennants, copper flower pot, miniature plain amber host token safely INSIDE, one blue guest pawn just through the open gate with a large green CHECK on its small approval ticket immediately beside it, clearly linked to approval and friendly welcome. At right OUTSIDE the wall, a separate second dark-turquoise simple request token is waiting on a small flat paper envelope with an HOURGLASS stamp, with no arrow going in and physical distance from the approved guest. SINGLE open gate and only these three non-character game markers, host/approved guest/waiting request. Host permission is the lesson: no prying open door, burglary, padlock picking, intrusion, threatening imagery or gadgets. No rendered words, digits, fake app screens or commands. Intricate layered card edges, felt daisies and natural shadows, clean nonverbal invitation, active expressive teamwork.
